items.title: US Stock Market Today: S&P 500 Futures Slip As Hawkish Fed And Strong Dollar Bite
items.summary: The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Friday, Nov, 20 2026 US stocks look set to open weaker, with the Fed’s hawkish message and a stronger dollar setting the tone. Futures selling points to risk appetite being reined in as investors reassess how restrictive policy might stay. The US Dollar Index is trading near 104, its highest since April 2025, after the Fed’s October minutes kept the door open to further hikes. Markets currently assign about a 90% chance of a 25 bps move next month...
